narr: Widespread showers developed ahead and near an upper level low pressure system during the late morning along the Arkansas border and expanded northward through the afternoon and evening. While precipitation amounts averaged around one quarter of an inch, an isolated storm developed over Vernon County just north of Nevada and dropped up to five inches of rain in a 3 hour period during the late afternoon and early evening. Flash flooding with this event caused a car to be swept off of C Highway near the town of Walker.
ev: A car was swept off the road on Highway C due to runoff from heavy rainfall that flooded a low water crossing. No injuries were reported.
lsr: A CAR WAS SWEPT OFF THE ROAD ON C HIGHWAY DUE TO RUN OFF FROM HEAVY RAINFALL JUST NORTH OF WALKER.
